data.title: Beijing imposes total ban on drones after deadly crash
data.description: Beijing has introduced stricter drone regulations, banning all uncrewed flights as well as the possession and storage of existing devices, while detailing disposal methods for the first time in an effort to strengthen security in the capital.

data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty offers Johan Ghazali flyweight fight – after ‘a couple wins’
data.description: Freddie Haggerty says he is willing to move up to flyweight to fight Johan Ghazali in ONE Championship – but wants him to pick up “a couple wins” before entertaining the match-up.

data.title: Remains exhumed, moved from unlicensed Jewish cemetery
data.description: CHACHOENGSAO - Four bodies were exhumed at an unlicensed Jewish cemetery in Bang Khla district and moved to a licensed cemetery in adjoining Chon Buri province on Tuesday morning.

data.title: 'Hands off Koh Kut': Thailand stands firm at UN maritme talks
data.description: Thailand has made its position clear during maritime border talks with Cambodia under the UN law of the sea - Koh Kut is not part of the reconciliation process.

data.title: Chinese procurer fleeing prison in China arrested in Thailand
data.description: A 32-year-old Chinese woman allegedly fleeing a prison term in China for procuring women for prostitution has been arrested on a roadside near Suvarnabhumi airport after earlier entering Thailand illegally.

data.title: Health agency reports 87,770 flu cases in August, with diarrhoea and Covid ranking next
data.description: Rabies led the case fatality ranking with one case and one death, while Thai officials urged stronger precautions against rising Covid infections

data.title: US military confirms Iran war has led to munitions shortfall
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States is facing a shortfall in ammunition as a result of its war against Iran, the Defense Department's inspector general confirmed Monday, contrasting with President Donald Trump's assertions of full stocks.

data.title: Berlin's run-down public spaces at heart of election campaign
data.description: BERLIN — Politicians campaigning for Sunday's Berlin state election have painted an unflattering picture of the German capital, vowing to clear garbage-strewn streets and promising "syringe-free playgrounds".

data.title: Illegal laughing gas factory busted in Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok police have shut down a Chinese-run factory in Prawet district that illegally produced and sold nitrous oxide, a mild anaesthetic also known as laughing gas and often used as a party drug.

data.title: Asian Games set for liftoff but will have everyone have a bed?
data.description: NAGOYA — The Asian Games open in Japan on Saturday with 2028 Olympics places up for grabs, fast-rising talents of world sport in action and thousands of athletes staying on a cruise ship in typhoon season.

data.title: Landslide damages school buildings in Nan, students relocated
data.description: NAN - An expanding landslide has forced the partial closure of a mountainside school, causing large cracks in a kindergarten building, a canteen, a shop and a swimming pool.

data.title: Phuket celebrates second Ganesh Chaturthi festival
data.description: PHUKET — Phuket started hosting its second Ganesh Chaturthi festival on Monday, bringing Thai and Indian communities together through religious ceremonies, cultural performances and a colourful procession through the historic Old Town.

data.title: Venus may have swallowed its moon

data.title: Asean cooperation 'key' to business resilience
data.description: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) must make better use of its combined market, deepen economic integration and ensure that smaller businesses share in regional growth if it is to remain competitive amid geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruption, business leaders told the 2026 World Knowledge Forum (WKF).

data.title: Number of centenarians in Japan tops 100,000 for 1st time
data.description: KYODO — The number of people aged 100 or older in Japan reached a record high of 107,677 in September, climbing for the 56th consecutive year, health ministry data showed Tuesday.

data.title: Bangkok clarifies Jewish site role
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has clarified that its authority over a proposed Jewish Association of Thailand building in Sukhumvit Soi 22 is limited to building control, while permits for cemeteries or crematoria require applicants to have lawful rights over the land.

data.title: SYMC Accelerates Growth with Four Strategic Drivers
data.description: BANGKOK – Symphony Communication Public Company Limited, or SYMC, has signalled a positive performance outlook for 2026, supported by a continued business recovery and sustained growth. The company is advancing four key Growth Drivers to capitalize on the AI, data centerand digital economy megatrends: accelerating its expansion in the enterprise market; enhancing network capacity to support the growth of AI and datacenters; expanding regional connectivity; and building stable, sustainable growth. These initiatives will enable SYMC to capture long-term opportunities arising from digital infrastructure and enterprise services.

data.title: Drone shot down by Nato over Lithuania
data.description: VILNIUS - North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (Nato) fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania, the Baltic state's president said Tuesday, in the latest security incident on the alliance's eastern flank during Russia's war with Ukraine.

data.title: Cambodia and Thailand begin UN-backed conciliation on maritime dispute
data.description: Foreign ​ministers of Cambodia and Thailand delivered opening statements on Tuesday at the first ​meeting of a UN arbitration ‌process to resolve a long-running maritime dispute between the two Southeast Asian neighbours.

data.title: US Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-in ballot restrictions
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Supreme Court dealt a major blow Monday to President Donald Trump's attempts to restrict mail-in voting before the November midterm elections, denying his request to lift an order halting the divisive plan.

data.title: New Zealand agencies missed red flags in child kidnapping case: inquiry
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand authorities failed to act on prior warnings that a man who went on the run with his kids for four years had a stash of guns and fears he would kidnap his children, an inquiry into a case that drew global headlines found Tuesday.
